customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` in workflows (cargo install pins and similar).

packageRules.description: Heavy automerge for everything: the CI suite (fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests against real OpenSCAD + Linux and macOS app builds + cargo-deny + dependency-review + CodeQL + Trivy) is the safety net, so anything that stays green merges itself.
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR.
GPUI Kit crates, the GPUI snapshot they pin, and tree-sitter (a native-linked crate gpui-component pins) must move together.
Protocol crates: group ACP schema and tree-sitter grammar bumps so protocol changes land in one reviewed-by-CI PR.
